title: Safe Footing Card
description: A mud-spotted card labeled "Gary — Route Check" marks the pale flagstones as safe footing and the dark stones as loose.
implication: The marked stones behave exactly as described; crossing on the pale stones avoids the unstable section.

title: West Bridge Warning
description: A folded warning signed "Gary" reads, "Do not trust the west side of the next bridge. The third support shifts under weight."
implication: The next bridge or raised crossing has a weakened third support on its west side; careful inspection confirms fresh movement.

title: Cell Latch Note
description: A tag bearing Gary's name reads, "The empty cell latches catch twice. Lift before pulling."
implication: One nearby cell has a concealed second catch; lifting its handle reveals a safe storage recess behind the door.

title: Pressure Mark Key
description: A chalk key titled "Gary's Floor Marks" identifies a small triangle as his warning for pressure plates.
implication: A matching triangle is scratched near a pressure plate in this room or the next suitable passage.

title: Brace Survey
description: A sheet titled "Gary's Survey — Lower Workings" marks two sound braces and one timber that should not be touched.
implication: The marked timber carries loose stone; the other braces offer secure handholds or anchor points.

title: Waterline Note
description: A waterproof note signed "Gary" reads, "The water rises after the second bell. The iron steps stay above it."
implication: The waterline confirms the warning, and an iron stair or ladder provides the safest route when the level rises.

title: Draft Test
description: A strip labeled "Gary — Draft Test" says the cold current leads toward breathable air.
implication: Following the cold draft identifies the least obstructed exit or a narrow ventilation route.

title: Arrow-Slit Warning
description: A guardhouse slip initialed "G." and issued to Gary marks two arrow slits as blocked and a third as clear.
implication: The third slit offers a sightline into the adjoining approach; the other two are packed with old debris.

title: Hinge Service Tag
description: A brass tag names Gary as the last person to oil a hidden hinge behind the nearest stone support.
implication: Careful investigation reveals the concealed hinge and a shallow maintenance compartment behind the support.

title: Lamp Schedule
description: A lamp-service card signed "Gary" lists the nearest fixtures and the order in which their oil should be replaced.
implication: The listed fixtures can be lit in that order; the final lamp illuminates an otherwise shadowed route marker.

title: Replacement Pin
description: A wrapped iron pin labeled "For Gary — north gate" includes measurements for the worn socket it fits.
implication: A nearby gate or portcullis has the matching worn socket; installing the pin steadies or releases it.

title: Drain Cleaning Stub
description: A work stub bearing Gary's name notes that the lower drain clogs after heavy runoff.
implication: The drain is beginning to clog; clearing its grate prevents the floor from flooding or reveals a small washed-in object.

title: Masonry Repair Tag
description: A repair tag signed "Gary" identifies three stones reset after a wall shifted.
implication: The three reset stones are sound; their different mortar also outlines a safe handhold and inspection seam.

title: Relay Inspection
description: A plain inspection card names Gary and records a relay that must be tapped once before use.
implication: The nearby relay responds to one firm tap and safely powers a light, door control, or inert indicator.

title: Patrol Timing
description: A pocket card labeled "Gary's Count" records the interval between two patrols without identifying either one.
implication: Tracks and distant sounds confirm the interval, giving the party time to prepare or move quietly.

title: Grocery List
description: A short list signed "Gary" reads, "Lamp oil, onions, chalk, tea. More tea than last time."
implication: A discarded oil wrapper and onion skin nearby suggest the practical list was recently used, but explain nothing else.

title: Far-Side Hinge
description: A repair tag bearing Gary's full name reads, "Safe only from the far side. Use the maintenance latch."
implication: A concealed maintenance latch on the opposite support releases the hinge without dropping the heavy panel.

title: Midnight Gallery Warning
description: A wax-sealed note signed "Gary" warns, "The sealed gallery is crossed after midnight. Wait for the dragging sound to pass."
implication: Scratches and residue support the warning; waiting through the sound leaves the route briefly clear.

title: Rope-Length Calculation
description: Gary's field card gives an exact rope length for a drop that appears much shallower from the edge.
implication: A weighted line confirms the stated depth and reveals a safe ledge at precisely the recorded distance.

title: False Handle Mark
description: A note signed "— Gary" reads, "Blue handle opens it. Brass handle rings the alarm."
implication: A faded blue handle is partly concealed by grime; the polished brass handle connects to an old warning bell.

title: Quarterly Lubrication
description: A maintenance sheet names Gary and lists an overdue wheel, chain, and hidden axle.
implication: A removable panel beside the mechanism exposes the axle; lubrication quiets and loosens all three components.

title: Calibration Sequence
description: A card signed "Gary" records the safe order for waking three dormant indicators.
implication: The indicators respond in the recorded sequence and expose which nearby conduit still carries power.

title: Pump Inspection
description: Gary's inspection log notes that the pump needs three slow turns before the stuck valve releases.
implication: Three deliberate turns free the valve; forcing it sooner would spill water into the work area.

title: Replacement Hatch Screws
description: A packet addressed to Gary holds four screws and says, "For the hatch nobody sees until the lantern is low."
implication: Lowering a light throws shadows across a concealed maintenance hatch whose four empty screw holes match the packet.

title: Gate Counterweight
description: A service note signed "Gary" records a counterweight that settles two inches before a gate can move.
implication: The counterweight visibly settles when pressure is applied; waiting for it prevents the gate from jamming.

title: Feeding Route
description: A field note labeled "Gary — observation 12" records that local creatures avoid the corridor immediately after feeding.
implication: Bones, scraps, and tracks reveal the feeding route and confirm a predictable quiet interval.

title: Current Reversal
description: Gary's water log says the current reverses briefly whenever the distant machinery stops.
implication: The current slackens exactly when the machinery falls silent, allowing a safer crossing or retrieval.

title: Stone Movement Log
description: A measurement sheet signed "Gary" records that one wall moves a finger-width each week.
implication: Old gauge marks confirm the motion and identify a widening seam that can serve as a narrow access point.

title: Patrol Exception
description: A patrol chart bearing Gary's name notes, "They skip the route when the red lamp is dark."
implication: Tracks bypass the room when its red lamp is extinguished, confirming the exception.

title: Guest Ledger
description: A ritual ledger truthfully lists Gary as both "prisoner received" and "guest expected" on the same date.
implication: Separate clerks made the entries for different doors, creating a misleading impression without falsifying either record.

title: Tea Margin
description: A precise route survey signed "Gary" ends with, "Tea cold again. Must learn to stop measuring while it is still drinkable."
implication: A ring from a cup sits beside the final measurement; every recorded dimension proves accurate.

title: Small Joke
description: A maintenance card initialed "G." and issued to Gary says, "This switch controls the light. The other switch controls regret."
implication: The first switch safely illuminates the area; the second is wired to a noisy but harmless maintenance alarm.

title: Recovering Walkway Note
description: A note signed "Gary" reads, "Step off after the fourth pulse. The walkway returns on the fifth."
implication: Wear marks and a repeating vibration confirm the timing; following it crosses the moving section safely.

title: Safe Barrier Test
description: Gary's test card says a temporary barrier drops when two floor marks are covered at once.
implication: Two faint matching marks activate the mechanism exactly as recorded when occupied simultaneously.

title: Repeated Repair Log
description: A repair log signed by Gary lists the same cracked support on six dates and adds, "It moves; it does not fail."
implication: The support flexes under load but returns to its mark; adjacent fixed stone is the actual brittle section.

title: Training Relay Note
description: A calibration note signed "Gary" reads, "Reset after every attempt. It is supposed to let them try again."
implication: A concealed reset panel restores the room's training device or moving feature after a failed attempt.

title: Spare Parts Cache
description: A manifest names Gary as recipient of gears, chalk, bandages, and tea, with "leave behind the narrow panel" added below.
implication: A concealed narrow panel contains a small cache of mundane replacement parts matching the manifest.

title: Adaptation Record
description: Gary's observation log notes that the local creatures changed routes after the party disturbed the upper levels.
implication: Newer tracks confirm the altered route and show which approach the creatures now watch.

title: Silence Interval
description: A memorandum signed "Gary" records seven breaths of silence before the dead react to a closing door.
implication: The delay is exact, allowing observant characters to move, hide, or prepare before attention shifts.

title: Water Memory
description: Gary's gauge sheet notes that the chamber drains to the same cracked tile after every surge.
implication: Stains converge on that tile; lifting it reveals a protected drain control or dry recess.

title: Previous Attempts
description: A tally titled "Gary's Notes — Attempts" records several solutions and circles the only one that required everyone to move together.
implication: Scuffs at several positions confirm the coordinated route and show where each participant stood.

title: Guard Response Study
description: Gary's study says the defenders reinforce whichever entrance makes the most noise and neglect the opposite side.
implication: Old response marks and current tracks support the pattern, offering a deliberate diversion opportunity.

title: Question in the Margin
description: A survey signed "Gary" asks, "Did you notice the second echo, or were you in a hurry again?"
implication: A second echo reveals a hollow wall and a concealed inspection cavity behind one of the room's supports.

title: Encouraging Correction
description: A route card signed "Gary" corrects three measurements and adds, "If you found all three errors, you are paying attention. Good."
implication: Each correction matches the room precisely; following them identifies the safest exit.

title: Shared Tea Reminder
description: A note headed "Gary — before they arrive" reads, "Fresh water, clean cups, patient questions. Do not lecture."
implication: A nearby water source is clean, and a protected shelf holds carefully washed but mismatched cups.

title: Sketch of Travelers
description: A page from Gary's notebook sketches a small group crossing a ruined plaza and asks, "Will they argue first, or look up?"
implication: Looking above the corresponding room reveals an overlooked balcony, route marker, or stable overhead anchor.

title: Lonely Inventory
description: Gary's inventory lists tools, food, lamps, and "one chair too many, in case somebody finally stays to talk."
implication: A serviceable extra chair has been repaired repeatedly and placed where it faces the safest entrance.

title: Survival Note
description: A folded page signed "Gary" reads, "If you are reading this, you survived the part I worried about most."
implication: Damage and repair marks show that the preceding route was once more dangerous and was deliberately made survivable.

title: Final Footing Lesson
description: A card signed "Gary" reads, "You know this mark now. Trust the circle, test the square, and leave the triangle alone."
implication: All three familiar marks behave consistently with earlier clues, rewarding the party for remembering them.

title: Last Inspection
description: A final inspection sheet signed "Gary" reads, "Everything you need still works. I checked twice because you are nearly here."
implication: Every listed mechanism functions, including a concealed access panel revealed by the sheet's measurements.

title: Teamwork Record
description: Gary's observation page reads, "You recover faster when nobody tries to solve everything alone. I hoped you would notice."
implication: Marks from earlier travelers show failed solo attempts beside one successful coordinated solution.

title: Courage Without Haste
description: A note signed "Gary" says, "You are brave. More importantly, you have learned when bravery should wait six seconds."
implication: A six-second mechanical cycle creates the exact safe opening described by the note.

title: Chosen Route Summary
description: Gary's route summary lists several choices the party could have made and concludes, "The route mattered less than why you chose it."
implication: The alternatives remain physically visible and viable, confirming that none was secretly the single correct path.

title: Learned Pattern
description: A card labeled "Gary's Final Observations" reads, "You stopped treating every moving wall as an enemy. Excellent."
implication: A moving wall nearby creates cover and a route when approached with the timing established in earlier rooms.

title: Reset Count
description: A counter log signed "Gary" records every reset and adds, "You tried again faster each time. That is part of the examination."
implication: A concealed counter advances only after failed attempts and resets the device so another solution remains possible.

title: Quiet Witness
description: A sealed note from Gary reads, "You showed kindness when nothing here required it. I was watching for that too."
implication: Evidence of a spared creature or respectfully handled resting place supports the observation without identifying the watcher.

title: Meeting Checklist
description: Gary's checklist reads, "Sweep. Tea. Moving bridges. Questions. Try not to look too pleased when they arrive for the meeting."
implication: A swept route and freshly prepared service alcove show that someone expects the party soon.

title: Almost Ready
description: A folded note signed "— Gary" reads, "I think you are finally ready. I hope I am."
implication: Fresh chalk arrows point onward, while a carefully repaired retreat route remains available behind the party.

title: Unsent Welcome
description: A letter in an envelope marked "From Gary, for whoever reaches me" begins, "You took longer than I guessed and less time than I feared."
implication: The paper and ink are recent, and the route named in its closing line is open exactly as promised.

title: Two Place Settings
description: Gary's note reads, "You may bring everyone. I was never going to make you choose who gets to meet me."
implication: A nearby table has enough mismatched settings for the whole party and one additional place.

title: Practice Greeting
description: A page titled "Gary — Final Greeting, revisions" contains several crossed-out welcomes and ends, "Hello. You made it. Good."
implication: The page is freshly blotted and lies beside a route that has just been cleared for the party.

title: Following Note
description: A pursuer's note truthfully says, "Gary is following you now," while a later line adds, "or perhaps preparing the way ahead."
implication: Tracks approach from behind but maintenance work appears ahead, encouraging an incomplete conclusion without making either observation false.

title: One Last Reminder
description: A note signed "Gary" reads, "Before we meet: watch your footing, listen to each other, and remember that the room is trying to teach you."
implication: The next mechanism telegraphs its cycle through floor marks and sound, exactly matching the reminder.

title: Open Invitation
description: A card bearing Gary's name reads, "The Final Examination is ahead. You may turn back. If you continue, come as you are."
implication: Both the onward route and a safe return path are genuinely open; no mechanism forces the choice.
